parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm at about 60 bpm with narrow QRS and left axis deviation. Voltage is high (S in V2 about 20 mm plus R in V5 about 17 mm is roughly 37 mm, above the 35 mm criterion). The concave ST elevation in V2-V4 with upright T waves is a repolarization pattern, not a STEMI. This is a borderline call against a normal ECG, because the voltage is only just over the threshold and the Cornell voltage (R in aVL plus S in V3, about 20 mm) is below its cutoff.
